observations: No realistic caller I can produce trips the limit today. The deployment's nginx sidecar sets X-Forwarded-For to the caller's own address and the broker trusts it, so each Dispatch pod and each Legion pod has its own bucket. Dispatch relays a few broker requests per page or decision, and the only other caller of the class, introspection, has no caller yet (Child A builds it). Once Child A lands, one Dispatch pod's introspections and its people's approval clicks share one bucket of fifty a second; a burst of introspections past that would answer an approval 429. That is for Child A's cache sizing, not this slice.
Per-process buckets (a fleet of N brokers allows N times the rate) are as the architect ruled and the file states; not raised as a finding.
